title: Size bound for independent multisets
statement: Fix a nonnegative integer $k$. For each nonnegative integer $n$, let $\Omega_n$ be a finite nonempty set and let $A_n$ map $\Omega_n$ into the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose that, for every $n$, the multiset of points given by $A_n$ has all nonempty Fourier coefficients indexed by sets of at most $k$ coordinates equal to zero. Then, as $n$ tends to infinity, $|\Omega_n|=O\!\left(n^{\lfloor k/2\rfloor}\right)$.
